plan.interpretation: I interpret this as a single acquisition email introducing Transistor to a solution-aware agency or network evaluating hosting for multiple shows. The email will lead with the multi-show operating model and ask the reader to start the documented 14-day free trial.
plan.reader:
Selected audience: Network or agency running multiple shows.
Research context describes some members of this market, not this recipient's installed tools or experiences. Follow the campaign request when it scopes the job.
Observed situation (grounded; check applicability): Agencies offering podcast production as a client service, hosting and managing multiple client (or internal) podcasts from one place rather than running each show as a one-off project.
plan.reader_segment: Network or agency running multiple shows
plan.promise: Transistor lets an agency run multiple podcasts in one account without an additional per-podcast charge and distribute their feeds to major listening apps.
plan.orientation: Transistor is a podcast hosting platform that publishes audio and video shows to the major listening apps and, on one paid account, lets an agency run more than one podcast without a per-podcast charge.
plan.arc: In one email, establish what Transistor is, show how its multi-show hosting and distribution model fits an agency roster, then offer the 14-day free trial as the single next step.
plan.sequence_rationale: The reader is already solution-aware, so the email should begin with the concrete operating advantage rather than explain podcast hosting. The multi-show proposition addresses the selected audience's defining job and is supported by product documentation; distribution shows what the agency can do with each feed, while the trial lowers the commitment of the next step. No researched failure of the reader's current approach is established, so the brief does not manufacture one. Can this source be supplied in a readable form or its missing details verified?

emails.selection_reason: This is the strongest supported fit for an agency managing a roster of shows: the account can contain additional podcasts without an added per-podcast charge, and Transistor can distribute their feeds to major listening apps.

value_case.reader_benefit: If the agency chooses an agency-owned hosting model, it can keep multiple client or internal podcasts under one Transistor account and publish each feed to major listening apps without an additional charge for each podcast.
value_case.mechanism: Transistor allows additional podcasts to be created on one account without an extra per-podcast charge and distributes podcasts to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, Overcast, Pocket Casts and other apps.
decision_conditions: The no-extra-per-podcast proposition applies to additional podcasts created on one account.
Plan download allowances are pooled across the account rather than granted separately to every show.

claim_conditions: The multi-show benefit is described for one paid account; do not present E23 as proof of specific trial entitlements.
Distribution is a documented capability, not a promise of audience growth or client results.
Do not promise: No claim that client users can be restricted to only their own show's dashboard
Do not promise: No claim of a ready-made client-facing analytics or ROI report
Do not promise: No claim about migrating existing shows off an incumbent host without disruption
Do not promise: No claim of headcount or time savings, growth outcomes, or cost comparison against any competitor
Do not promise: No claim that video publishing, dynamic ads or branding removal are available on the trial or on the entry plan
Do not promise: No claim that video publishing, dynamic ads, or branding removal are available on the trial or on the entry (Starter) plan
Do not promise: No claim that the pooled download allowance scales per added show without upgrading plans
This is a documented-use draft, not proof of the broader audience hypothesis or recipient fit.

Keep the connection route attached to its cited source. A native or prebuilt integration and a custom HTTP/webhook endpoint are separate setup paths unless the source explicitly equates them. A platform name alone establishes neither manual endpoint configuration nor a no-setup connector. Keep unknown setup requirements unknown; do not mix the steps or benefits of those paths.

emails.next_step_decision: Decide whether to begin evaluating Transistor as the hosting account for an agency's next show.

plan.voice_notes: Use short, direct sentences and Transistor's practical vocabulary: shows, feeds, publish and distribute. Keep the email focused on the multi-show operation and one CTA.

email.headline: Run multiple podcasts from one account
email.body:
Bring your client and internal podcasts into one Transistor account. Transistor is a podcast hosting platform for publishing and distributing shows.

On one paid account, you can create additional podcasts without another per-podcast charge. Each feed can be distributed to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, Overcast, Pocket Casts and other apps.

That gives each new show a clear home and a route to major listening apps. Your plan’s monthly download allowance is shared across all shows on the account.

Start a 14-day free trial and see whether Transistor fits the way you want to run your next show.
